claude_proposed_widenings.name: TemplatedCapacity.spellcasting_ability_modifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The SRD says capacity = 'your spellcasting ability modifier', which is class-dependent (CHA for Bard/Sorcerer, INT for Wizard). TemplatedCapacity requires a specific Ability, making it impossible to represent the spell-class-neutral capacity without hardcoding one ability and being wrong for all other classes.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The maximum number of objects is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier
